typography.rules: Use tight tracking for headings. Standardize on Inter as explicitly requested. Use tabular-nums for numeric inputs in the Bill Style tab.

colors.rules: Use F26B33 for primary actions (Save buttons, active radio borders) and 329937 for active toggles or success states.

visual_enhancers.pill_tabs: bg-[#F3F4F6] p-1 rounded-lg flex space-x-1. Active tab: bg-white text-[#1A1A1A] shadow-sm. Inactive tab: text-[#6B7280] hover:text-[#1A1A1A].
visual_enhancers.cards: bg-white border border-[#E5E7EB] rounded-lg shadow-sm overflow-hidden
visual_enhancers.inline_forms: bg-[#F7F7F7] border border-[#E5E7EB] rounded-md p-4 mt-2
visual_enhancers.toggles: Custom styled Shadcn switches using #329937 for 'checked' state
visual_enhancers.surfaces: Use crisp 1px borders and slight shadows. No heavy neumorphism, lean towards Swiss/High-Contrast data interfaces.

grids.tab_4_dense_grid: grid grid-cols-12 gap-2 items-center py-2 border-b border-[#E5E7EB] last:border-0

layouts.container: w-full max-w-4xl mx-auto bg-white min-h-[80vh] flex flex-col
layouts.header: px-6 py-4 border-b border-[#E5E7EB] flex items-center justify-between sticky top-0 bg-white z-10
layouts.density: High density for Tab 4 (Bill Style). Use py-2 for rows instead of py-4. Reduce gaps to fit 28 configurable sections seamlessly.

motion.tabs: Instant switch with subtle opacity fade (duration-150 ease-in-out)
motion.hover: Subtle background shifts (hover:bg-[#F3F4F6]) for table rows and buttons
motion.inline_form: Animate height/opacity when expanding the Add/Edit Station inline form

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all #6B7280 text is sufficiently dark against #F7F7F7 and #FFFFFF backgrounds.
accessibility.data_testid: ALL interactive elements MUST include explicit data-testid attributes (e.g., 'tab-printers', 'btn-save-station', 'toggle-auto-serve').

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the UI in React using Javascript (.js/.jsx) with Tailwind CSS.
Do not build a full-page layout; build a settings panel structure (e.g., a polished div that could fit in a slide-over).
For Tab 1: Build the top 'Printing Mode' as 3 radio cards using the Primary Orange (#F26B33) for active border/ring.
For Tab 1: Build a dense data table for stations. Implement the inline Add/Edit form using `inline_form_grid` inside a `bg-[#F7F7F7]` bounded box.
For Tab 2: Map stations to employees. Add a 'Default Users' section at the top.
For Tab 3: Use a 2-column layout for the global bill config toggles and inputs.

For Tab 4: Implement nested pill tabs for '2-inch (58mm)', '3-inch (80mm)', and 'Windows'. Create a dense, spreadsheet-like list for the 28 configurable sections with visible toggles and font-size inputs (array values).
Ensure humanized labels for Tab 4 sections (e.g., 'Restaurant Logo' instead of 'restaurant_logo').
Use lucide-react for all icons. Explicitly no emojis.
Adhere strictly to the provided color hex codes. No generic tailwind blues.
All inputs/buttons/toggles must have specific data-testid attributes based on their functional names.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Never use generic centered layouts. Left-align dense data for readability.
Implement crisp micro-interactions: use structural grays (#F7F7F7 to #F3F4F6 on hover) rather than shadows for list items.
Use Shadcn UI components for complex interactions (Select, Switch, Tabs) but style them to match the exact brand tokens.
Do not apply global transitions (transition-all). Target specific properties.
Use exact spacing scale (Tailwind standard) but apply tighter gaps (gap-2, p-2) in 'spreadsheet' areas like Tab 4.
Ensure 'Save' buttons are prominent, using the primary #F26B33 color with proper hover states.
Toasts: use sonner for any save action feedback.
